Council Member Lili Navarrete's announcement that she plans to resign her position effective July 1, 2025, has initiated the council process to fill a vacancy on the City Council, representing District 2, Position 2.

* **Friday, May 23, 2025:** opening of the application period. Applications will be available on the City's website, the City Council offices (7th Floor, City Hall), and at the MySpokane service desk (1st Floor, City Hall).
* **Friday, June 20, 2025:** applications for appointment to the vacant Council position must be received by the City Clerk's office no later than 5:00 p.m.
* The City Council intends to conduct interviews of applicants on **Thursday, July 10, 2025**. All interviews shall be conducted by the entire City Council during a publicly noticed Council meeting and shall be open to the public.
* **Monday, July 14, 2025:** after conducting interview of the individual candidates, the council will hold a public hearing during a regular legislative session to accept testimony from the public regarding potential candidates.
* The City Council intends to vote, in open session, to fill the Council vacancy on July 28, 2025.

Applicants for this Council seat must have lived in City Council District 2 since at least July 28, 2024.

The individual appointed to this Council seat would serve approximately four months, serving until the current election for the District 2, Position 2 City Council seat is certified.
